passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto included in Item 8, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data." In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties, and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated by these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors. We discuss factors that we believe could cause or contribute to these differences below and elsewhere in this report, including those set forth under Item 1A, "Risk Factors." Refer to Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" contained in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, for the results of operations discussion for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, compared to the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024, other than as described below with respect to segment results from operations. OVERVIEW We are the advanced, end-to-end manufacturing partner of choice that helps a diverse customer base design, build, deliver and manage innovative products that improve the world. Through the collective strength of a global workforce across approximately 30 countries with responsible, sustainable operations, we deliver technology innovation, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions to diverse industries and end markets. The Company’s full suite of specialized capabilities includes design and engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and integrated services, plus a portfolio of power and cooling products. Over time, we have built differentiated scale and expertise across both technology-driven and regulated markets, enabling us to support customers with increasingly complex product, infrastructure, and compliance requirements. We partner with customers across a diverse set of industries including data center, healthcare, industrial, automotive, communications, and lifestyle. In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, the Company changed how it reports its operating results to its Chief Operating Decision Maker (“CODM”), principally reflecting the growth of Flex’s data center‑related businesses. As a result, the Company reorganized its operating structure and established a new operating and reportable segment, Cloud and Power Infrastructure (“CPI”) and updated its former segments from Flex Agility Solutions and Flex Reliability Solutions to Integrated Technology Solutions (“ITS”) and Regulated Manufacturing Solutions (“RMS”). Certain prior‑period segment information has been recast to conform to the current presentation. The determination of the separate operating and reportable segments is based on several factors, including the nature of products and services, the nature of production processes, customer base, delivery channels and similar economic characteristics. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below. You should carefully consider the following risks and all of the other information contained in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before investing in any of our securities. The risks and uncertainties described below reflect management’s beliefs as to material risks and are not the only risks we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that materially adversely affect our business. If any of the following risks, or other risks and uncertainties that are not yet identified or that we currently think are immaterial, actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our ordinary shares could decline. References to past events are provided by way of example only. We may amend, supplement or add to the risk factors described below from time to time in future reports filed with the SEC. Summary of Risk Factors The following is a summary of the principal risks and uncertainties that management believes could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. You should read this summary together with the more detailed description of each risk factor contained below. 10 Table of Contents • Global economic conditions and geopolitical uncertainty have in the past adversely affected, and could in the future adversely affect, our business, results of operations, financial condition, and access to capital markets. • The planned spin-off of our Cloud and Power Infrastructure businesses may not be completed on the terms or timeline currently contemplated, if at all, and involves significant costs and risks. • Tariffs, trade restrictions, export controls, and changes in trade policy, including heightened trade volatility and uncertainty regarding trade agreements, have in the past adversely affected, and could in the future adversely affect, our business, results of operations, and financial condition. • Customer order cancellations, production changes, and demand variability could adversely affect our business. • A significant percentage of our sales come from a small number of customers and a decline in sales to any of our largest customers has in the past adversely affected, and could in the future adversely affect, our business, results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition. • Investments in our Cloud and Power Infrastructure businesses may adversely affect our margins, and demand for these offerings is subject to factors outside our control. • We may incur significant losses if customer-specific capital equipment becomes impaired or obsolete. • Supply chain disruptions and demand forecasting failures have in the past adversely affected, and could in the future adversely affect, our ability to meet customer demand, and lead to higher costs, or result in excess or obsolete inventory

credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds shareholder buybacks, so distributions are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing, leaving the capital structure intact. Cash conversion is steady across the trend, and the buyback programme does not appear to crowd out the working capital and capex needs of a contract manufacturer.

Gross leverage improved year over year and net leverage sits well inside the next risk-band boundary, with EBITDA able to absorb a substantial decline before the profile shifts. The indicative financial risk profile is Minimal on both leverage and cash-flow tiers, supported by a growing operating income trend.

key_risks.text: The planned spin-off of the Cloud and Power Infrastructure businesses may not complete on the contemplated terms or timeline and carries significant costs and execution risk, while investment in those businesses may pressure margins. Segment reorganisation around CPI, ITS and RMS adds reporting and operational complexity during the separation.

Customer concentration is a disclosed structural risk: a significant share of sales comes from a small number of customers, and lost programmes or order cancellations would hit revenue and cash flow quickly. Tariffs, export controls and trade-policy volatility compound demand variability for a geographically dispersed manufacturing footprint.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains comfortably above unity, with operating income covering gross interest expense several times over. EBITDA-based coverage is likewise adequate, though both measures trail the sector median, reflecting the thin margins typical of contract manufacturing rather than any structural funding weakness.

Free cash flow covers buybacks with modest headroom, and free cash flow to debt is slightly lower than the prior year and below the sector median. Liquidity is adequate: the current ratio exceeds unity and improved year over year, though it remains below the sector median, and no material near-term maturities are disclosed.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is solid: leverage is modest on a net basis, coverage is adequate and free cash flow is positive after capex, supporting an indicative Minimal financial risk profile. Leverage sits above the sector median and coverage below it, so the issuer is a sound but not top-quartile credit within Information Technology.

Our forward view is that deleveraging continues only if cash flow holds and buybacks stay within free cash flow; the spin-off, customer concentration and trade-policy exposure are the main swing factors. Thin operating margins leave limited cushion, so we would monitor segment disclosure and distribution policy closely.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流穩健地超過股東回購，因此分派乃由內部產生之現金而非新增借貸撥付，資本結構得以維持不變。現金轉換於整個趨勢中保持穩定，而回購計劃似乎並無擠佔一家合約製造商之營運資金及資本開支需求。
總槓桿按年改善，淨槓桿穩處於下一個風險區間邊界之內，EBITDA 能夠承受大幅下降而信貸狀況方會轉變。指示性財務風險狀況於槓桿及現金流兩項分層均為極低，並有持續增長的經營收入趨勢支持。

key_risks.text: 雲端及電力基礎設施業務之計劃分拆可能無法按預期條款或時間表完成，並涉及重大成本及執行風險，而對該等業務之投資可能對利潤率構成壓力。圍繞 CPI、ITS 及 RMS 之業務分部重組，於分拆期間增加報告及營運複雜性。
客戶集中度為已披露之結構性風險：相當比例之銷售額來自少數客戶，一旦失去項目或訂單取消，將迅速打擊收入及現金流。關稅、出口管制及貿易政策波動，令地理上分散之製造佈局之需求波動性加劇。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善，並穩健地高於一倍，經營收入覆蓋總利息支出數倍以上。以 EBITDA 為基礎之覆蓋率同樣充足，惟兩項指標均落後於行業中位數，反映合約製造商典型之微薄利潤率，而非任何結構性融資弱點。
自由現金流覆蓋回購並有溫和餘裕，而自由現金流對債務比率略低於上一年度及低於行業中位數。流動性充足：流動比率高於一倍並按年改善，惟仍低於行業中位數，且並無披露重大近期到期債務。

overall_credit_view.text: 信貸狀況穩健：淨槓桿溫和，覆蓋率充足，且資本開支後自由現金流為正，支持指示性極低財務風險狀況。槓桿高於行業中位數而覆蓋率低於中位數，故該發行人於資訊科技行業中屬穩健但非頂尖四分位之信貸。
我們之前瞻觀點為：只有在現金流保持且回購維持於自由現金流之內時，去槓桿方會持續；分拆、客戶集中度及貿易政策風險為主要變數。微薄之經營利潤率留下有限緩衝，故我們將密切監察分部披露及分派政策。
